methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch. Where the official page rendered JS-only or returned errors, reputable aggregator pages (SoftwareAdvice, GetApp, Zapier blog) were used as primary source and noted in provenance. All prices are USD. Per-seat plans show the cost for one seat/user as the smallest billable unit. Annual prices are the effective monthly rate (annual total divided by 12). Month-to-month rates are noted in plan notes where both billing periods are published. Vendors with no public self-serve price are included with null monthlyUsd. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 for all sources.

vendors.name: Toggl Track
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://toggl.com/track/pricing/ fetched directly and corroborated by Tekpon and CostBench listings. Starter is $9/user/month annual ($10 month-to-month); Premium is $18/user/month annual ($20 month-to-month). The displayed $9/$18 figures are the ANNUAL rates; the 'Save 10%' applies between annual and the higher monthly rates.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 users, basic time tracking, 100+ integrations, calendar syncing.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually at $9/user/month ($108/user/year). Month-to-month rate is $10/user/month. Includes billable rates, revenue analysis, project estimates.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually at $18/user/month ($216/user/year). Month-to-month rate is $20/user/month. Includes profitability analysis, fixed-fee projects, scheduled reports, timesheet approvals, Jira/Salesforce integration, SSO.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes dedicated customer success manager, personalized onboarding, custom integrations, multiple workspaces.
